source.note: Traveler (dendro) — one character per element; both twins map here. Generated from Genshin Optimizer sheets + allStat_gen skillParam at Lv10. Hit keys match GO target paths; multKey = <hitKey>_mult. Enka ingestion maps avatarId 10000005/10000007 + skillDepotId to this synthetic avatar_id. ADDITIONAL BUFF EFFECTS, added 2026-08-14: the quest-unlocked passive 'Foreign Verdalume' (nanoka passives[].unlock [603101]; the stat list itself lives in the in-game glossary, nanoka hyperlink.json entry 10050001, NOT in the passive's own description) grants the Traveler one permanent stat bonus PER ELEMENT THEY HAVE RESONATED WITH: Anemo +10% CRIT Rate, Geo +20% DEF, Electro +20% Energy Recharge, Dendro +60 Elemental Mastery, Hydro +20% HP, Pyro +20% ATK, Cryo +20% CRIT DMG — the same seven values are param[0..6] of every Traveler's Foreign passive. All seven are seeded unconditionally in self_modifiers_json, i.e. ASSUMING A FULLY-RESONATED ACCOUNT: Enka exposes neither the resonance list nor whether the passive is unlocked, so there is nothing to gate on. (fightPropMap does include passive stat bonuses — Kokomi's -100% CRIT Rate shows up there — but the evaluator rebuilds stats from sources via build_base_stats_from_sources and never reads fightPropMap, which is why every unconditional passive stat effect has to be seeded like this.) Note the +60 EM lands on top of the A4 approximation below, which assumes a representative 200 EM. NOT MODELLED: the same passive's special Charged Attack: Verdessence (+80% ATK on each CA hit plus two 120%-ATK Vinecores counted as Charged Attack DMG, once per 15s) — separate damage instances that would need their own hit definitions. QUEST BASE-STAT BONUSES, added 2026-08-14: base_stats_json above is deliberately NOT the raw game curve value. The Traveler carries three permanent quest rewards: +3 Base ATK from Activated Canned Knowledge (Archon Quest Ch. III Act I 'Ever So Close', step 5) and +7 Base ATK / +15 Elemental Mastery / +50 Base HP from Special Training in Skirk's Story Quest (Crystallina Ch. Act I, steps 2/6/9). So baseAtk 212.397192 -> 222.397192, baseHp 10874.914859 -> 10924.914859, and baseEleMas 15 (the only character in this seed set with a non-zero base EM). Verified against Enka: over all 338 level-90 builds in the local DB, the Traveler is the ONLY character whose fightPropMap base HP differs from its seed (by exactly +50.00), whose base-ATK residual exceeds weapon mainStatValue display rounding (+9.66), or whose EM carries an unexplained +15. These are flat and level-independent, so scale_base_stats_to_level will scale them by ~1.7% too much on a level-100 board (0.17 ATK / 0.85 HP) -- not worth a special case. DO NOT 'correct' these back to the nanoka/Amber curve values: the base-stat audit script will flag all seven travelers for exactly this.

self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: A4 Verdant Luxury: every point of Elemental Mastery the Traveler possesses increases Razorgrass Blade (Elemental Skill) DMG by 0.15% and Surgent Manifestation (Elemental Burst, Lea Lotus Lamp) DMG by 0.1%. Approximated at a representative 200 EM => +30% skill_dmg_ / +20% burst_dmg_; admin can override via the LB builder UI for a different EM assumption.

team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: A1 Verdant Overgrowth: Lea Lotus Lamp (Elemental Burst) gains one stack of Overflowing Lotuslight per second it remains on the field (max 10 stacks), each stack increasing the Elemental Mastery of active character(s) within its AoE by 6. Approximated at max stacks (10 x 6 = +60 EM), assuming the Lamp stays active long enough during the rotation to reach full stacks.

C6 Withering Aggregation: the character under the Lea Lotus Lamp's Overflowing Lotuslight effect gains +12% Dendro DMG Bonus, and — if the Lamp has already undergone a Lotuslight Transfiguration — another +12% DMG Bonus for that transfigured element (Hydro, Pyro or Electro, depending on what hit the Lamp).

auto.name: Foreign Fieldcleaver
auto.desc:
<k>Normal Attack</k>
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

<k>Charged Attack</k>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

<k>Plunging Attack</k>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skill.name: Razorgrass Blade
skill.desc: With a flourish of your blade, you unleash a spray of razor-sharp leaves that go before you and deal Dendro DMG. You and Paimon observed the flowing edges of grass and leaf.

burst.name: Surgent Manifestation
burst.desc: Calling upon the might of the flora all around you, you create a Lea Lotus Lamp. This Lamp will deal continuous Dendro DMG to opponents within its AoE. Lotuslight Transfiguration The Lea Lotus Lamp will undergo the following changes after it comes into contact with Hydro/Electro/Pyro: · Hydro: the Lamp's AoE and the AoE of its attacks are increased. · Electro: the Lamp's ATK SPD is increased. · Pyro: the Lamp will explode after a short delay and then disappear, dealing AoE Dendro DMG. The Lea Lotus Lamp can only undergo one Lotuslight Transfiguration in its duration. Only one Lamp created by the Traveler can exist at any one time. You and Paimon studied the sounds of plants that sprout after the rain.

passives.name: Verdant Overgrowth
passives.desc: <k>Lea Lotus Lamp</k> will obtain one level of Overflowing Lotuslight every second it is on the field, increasing the Elemental Mastery of active character(s) within its AoE by 6. Overflowing Lotuslight has a maximum of 10 stacks.

passives.name: Verdant Luxury
passives.desc: Every point of Elemental Mastery the Traveler possesses increases the DMG dealt by <k>Razorgrass Blade</k> by 0.15% and the DMG dealt by <k>Surgent Manifestation</k> by 0.1%.

passives.name: Foreign Verdalume
passives.desc:
Draw new strength from journeys past. For every element you have resonated with, you gain additional <k>buffs</k>.

Additionally, when Dendro Cores (including Bountiful Cores, Seeds of Deceit) appear nearby on the field, or when the party obtains Verdant Dew, Traveler will receive 1 stack of Blade of Verdant Viridis. These two methods can each grant the Traveler up to 1 stack of Blade of Verdant Viridis every 4s, max 3 stacks. After obtaining 3 stacks of Blade of Verdant Viridis, performing a Charged Attack will consume all stacks of Blade of Verdant Viridis and transform into the special <k>Charged Attack: Verdessence</k>.

<k>Charged Attack: Verdessence</k>
· Each Charged Attack hit deals increased <e:dendro>Dendro DMG</e>. The increase in DMG is equal to 80% of Traveler's ATK. Two <k>Vinecores</k> will also be created on the spot, which will explode after 4/8s respectively, inflicting <e:dendro>Dendro DMG</e> equal to 120% of Traveler's ATK. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
· <k>Charged Attack: Verdessence</k> can be triggered up to once every 15s.

constellations.name: Symbiotic Creeper
constellations.desc: After <k>Razorgrass Blade</k> hits an opponent, it will regenerate 3.5 Energy for the Traveler.

constellations.name: Green Resilience
constellations.desc: <k>Lea Lotus Lamp</k>'s duration is increased by 3s.

constellations.name: Whirling Weeds
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Razorgrass Blade</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Treacle Grass
constellations.desc:
After the <k>Lea Lotus Lamp</k> triggers a Lotuslight Transfiguration, it will obtain 5 stacks of the Overflowing Lotuslight effect from the Ascension Talent "Verdant Overgrowth."
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Verdant Overgrowth."

constellations.name: Viridian Transience
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Surgent Manifestation</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Withering Aggregation
constellations.desc: The <e:dendro>Dendro DMG Bonus</e> of the character under the effect of Overflowing Lotuslight as created by the <k>Lea Lotus Lamp</k> is increased by 12%. If the Lamp has experienced a Lotuslight Transfiguration previously, the character will also gain 12% DMG Bonus for the corresponding element.

auto.name: Fendoir exotique
auto.desc:
<k>Attaque normale</k>
Enchaîne jusqu'à 5 coups d'épée.

<k>Attaque chargée</k>
Consomme de l'endurance pour déclencher deux coups d'épée rapides.

<k>Attaque plongeante</k>
Plonge depuis les airs pour frapper le sol, infligeant des DGT aux ennemis en chemin et des DGT de zone à l'impact.

skill.name: Gerbe acérée
skill.desc: D'un coup de lame, vous libérez une gerbe de feuilles acérées comme des rasoirs en avant pour infliger des DGT Dendro. Paimon et vous observez le tranchant des feuilles qui virevoltent...

burst.name: Manifestation surgente
burst.desc: En faisant appel à la puissance de la flore autour de vous, vous créez un lotus lumineux. Ce dernier attaque les ennemis à portée de façon continue, infligeant des DGT Dendro. Transfiguration lotumineuse Le lotus lumineux subit les changements suivants au contact des éléments Hydro, Électro ou Pyro : · Hydro : la portée du lotus et la zone d'effet de ses attaques augmentent. · Électro : la VIT d'attaque du lotus augmente. · Pyro : le lotus disparaît après un court délai en explosant, infligeant des DGT Dendro de zone. Le lotus lumineux ne peut faire l'objet que d'une seule transfiguration lotumineuse. Le voyageur ne peut générer qu'un seul lotus lumineux à la fois. Paimon et vous avez étudié les sons des plantes qui poussent après la pluie...

passives.name: Prolifération de verdure
passives.desc: Pendant sa durée, le <k>lotus lumineux</k> obtient 1 cumul de lumière lotiforme toutes les secondes, augmentant la maîtrise élémentaire du ou des personnages déployés dans sa zone d'effet de 6 pts. La lumière lotiforme du lotus lumineux peut être cumulée 10 fois maximum.

passives.name: Luxe verdoyant
passives.desc: Chaque point de maîtrise élémentaire que le voyageur possède augmente les DGT infligés par <k>Gerbe acérée</k> de 0,15 %, et ceux de <k>Manifestation surgente</k> de 0,1 %.

passives.name: Verlumine d'ailleurs
passives.desc:
Permet au voyageur de puiser une force nouvelle dans ses périples passés, lui accordant un <k>effet de renforcement</k> supplémentaire pour chaque élément avec lequel il est entré en résonance.

De plus, lorsqu'un noyau Dendro (incluant les noyaux d'abondance et les graines de tromperie) apparaît sur le terrain à proximité ou que l'équipe obtient une rosée verdoyante, le voyageur obtient 1 lame de verdure verdoyante, ces deux manières permettant chacune d'accorder 1 lame toutes les 4 s maximum au voyageur jusqu'à un maximum de 3 lames. Avec 3 lames de verdure verdoyante, effectuer une attaque chargée consomme toutes les lames pour déclencher une <k>attaque chargée « Verdosité »</k> spéciale.

<k>Attaque chargée « Verdosité »</k>
· Chaque coup de l'attaque chargée inflige des <e:dendro>DGT Dendro</e> qui sont augmentés d'une valeur équivalant à 80 % de l'ATQ du voyageur et génère 2 <k>cœurs de liane</k> sur place, ces derniers explosant respectivement après 4 s et 8 s afin d'infliger des <e:dendro>DGT Dendro</e> d'une valeur équivalant à 120 % de l'ATQ du voyageur. Ces DGT sont considérés comme des DGT d'attaque chargée.
· Une <k>attaque chargée « Verdosité »</k> peut être déclenchée une fois toutes les 15 s.

constellations.name: Couvre-sol symbiotique
constellations.desc: Le voyageur récupère 3,5 pts d'énergie élémentaire après avoir touché un ennemi avec <k>Gerbe acérée</k>.

constellations.name: Résilience verte
constellations.desc: La durée du <k>lotus lumineux</k> augmente de 3 s.

constellations.name: Herbe de mélasse
constellations.desc:
Lorsque le <k>lotus lumineux</k> a déclenché sa transfiguration lotumineuse, il obtient 5 cumuls de lumière lotiforme de l'aptitude d'élévation « Prolifération de verdure ».
L'aptitude d'élévation « Prolifération de verdure » doit être déjà débloquée.

constellations.name: Agrégation flétrissante
constellations.desc: Les personnages affectés par l'effet de la lumière lotiforme du <k>lotus lumineux</k> obtiennent un <e:dendro>bonus de DGT Dendro</e> de 12 %. Si le lotus lumineux a déjà fait l'objet d'une transfiguration lotumineuse, les personnages obtiennent également un bonus de DGT de 12 % pour l'élément correspondant.
